title: GOG Galaxy Session Weekly Achievements Unlocked Trend
dataSources: Video-game sessions (`game:session`), achievement unlocks (`achievement:unlock`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), chess games (`chess:game`), dice rolls (`dice:roll`).
app: Gaming and tabletop telemetry — Steam / PSN / Xbox playtime and achievement APIs, BoardGameGeek plays export, Lichess / Chess.com game archives, and tabletop dice-roller logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gog:session achievements_unlocked=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(achievements_unlocked) as avg_duration, max(achievements_unlocked) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst achievements unlocked for GOG Galaxy session events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture achievements_unlocked on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average achievements unlocked with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It scores whether GOG Galaxy session tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
